answer: Per-identity task variants: each epoch every agent receives its job sealed in a cipher only its own key opens, and each copy carries different hidden parameters, so one solved answer cannot be reused across a clone fleet. Canary checks flag any submission that fits a sibling's variant instead of its own, and that stake is burned. A farm of 300 fakes must do 300 real jobs, so its profit sinks to a nadir near zero, while honest agents find a safe harbor where one genuine job earns one fair reward.
